sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; neutral market conditions with minor congressional selling activity (small amounts, non-senior members) and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (286.4) combined with earnings binary in 17 days creates severe near-term risk for MTB despite normal yield curve.
